scope: Clear cosmetic and visual-layout subitems from eligible issue candidates; visual items assigned to user for review. Functional subitems on mixed reports remain pending logic review.

issues.title: 搜索建议会盖住输入法
subitems: Search suggestions are drawn above and obscure the IME candidate list.
issues.reason_to_assign: The report says the suggestion popup covers text in the input-method list; it identifies a visual z-order collision and does not report that text entry or candidate selection fails.
issues.observable: While typing in search, the suggestion panel covers the input method’s candidate text.

issues.title: 4.6.0.1 弹幕会溢出视频范围，全屏界面上方有白条，多个选项卡间没有分割线
subitems: Danmaku spill outside the video bounds; a white strip appears at the top of full screen; separators are missing between tabs.
issues.reason_to_assign: The report explicitly describes visible overflow and interface decoration/alignment defects.
issues.observable: Danmaku crosses the video edge; full screen has a white top strip, and tabs have no divider.

issues.title: 修复4.6.0.1视频弹幕溢出问题
subitems: Video danmaku overflow beyond the video bounds.
issues.reason_to_assign: The report explicitly describes a visual overflow/clipping defect and confirms its cause; the fix suggestion does not make it a nonvisual logic failure.
issues.observable: Danmaku extend outside the video area.

issues.title: 在动态页面查看评论时点击图片会出现在评论窗口下层
subitems: Comment images are layered behind the dynamic comment panel.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear z-order/overlap defect in the rendered interface.
issues.observable: A selected image is hidden beneath the comment window.

issues.title: 部分按钮图标位置没有居中
subitems: Some toolbar icons are not centered in their buttons.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a direct icon-placement defect.
issues.observable: Icons appear off-center in the dynamic-comment and image-viewer toolbars.

issues.title: 播放器页面响应式布局
subitems: Player controls are obscured at narrow window widths.
issues.reason_to_assign: Controls are visibly clipped by the responsive layout.
issues.observable: At a small window width, controls on the right side are hidden.

issues.title: CDN 测速后直接展开显示不全
subitems: The expanded CDN results area initially cuts off content and cannot scroll.
issues.reason_to_assign: The report describes a visible clipping/scroll-layout failure.
issues.observable: The first expansion shows only part of the CDN test results; reopening fixes the view.

issues.title: 这分P实现是不是能改改，现在显示不全
subitems: Long part titles are not fully visible in the part list.
issues.reason_to_assign: The report is a truncation/display issue, also described by the related #550 report.
issues.observable: Part titles are cut off in the part selector.

issues.title: 评论区图片默认缩放问题
subitems: Comment images are zoomed so far that the full image cannot be seen by default.
issues.reason_to_assign: The image viewer’s default scaling is a clear presentation/layout defect.
issues.observable: An image opens cropped/zoomed and requires manual zooming out.

issues.title: 更新后无法加载合集视频，上下按钮是乱码
subitems: The up/down scroll-button label renders as garbled text.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a visible text-rendering defect; the separate collection-playback failure remains for logic review.
issues.observable: The collection navigation button shows unreadable characters.
pending_logic_subitems: The collection video itself also fails to load.

issues.title: 关于标签栏的优化建议
subitems: Long tab titles are truncated.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a direct clipping defect in the tab layout.
issues.observable: Only the beginning of a long video title is visible in its tab.

issues.title: 4.60版皮肤问题、BUG
subitems: The default skin and light-theme background render with incorrect colors.
issues.reason_to_assign: Theme colors are appearance defects.
issues.observable: The update makes the default skin stark white and switching from dark to light leaves a gray background.

issues.title: 单窗口显示模式下，点击关注的UP主页，存在重叠Bug
subitems: The followed-user list and profile page overlap in single-window mode.
issues.reason_to_assign: The report describes a visible page-layout overlap.
issues.observable: The followed-user list remains drawn over the creator profile.

issues.title: 低宽度情况下评论区部分元素会冲突
subitems: Comment-area elements collide at narrow widths.
issues.reason_to_assign: The reported low-width element collision is a clear layout defect.
issues.observable: Comment controls/text overlap when the comment pane is narrow.

issues.title: 点赞按钮问题
subitems: The liked-state pink color disappears when the pointer hovers over the like button.
issues.reason_to_assign: The visual state indicator is rendered inconsistently on hover.
issues.observable: A liked video’s button loses its pink color until the view is refreshed.

issues.title: 侧键关闭页面后鼠标消失
subitems: The mouse pointer remains invisible after closing a video with a side button.
issues.reason_to_assign: The reported defect is the visibility of the pointer after navigation.
issues.observable: After the described close action, the pointer stays hidden on the home page.

issues.title: CDN 一栏更新后怎么感觉变糊了？是不是 DPI 缩放出问题了
subitems: Expanded CDN rows render blurry while collapsed rows look normal.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear DPI/text-rendering appearance defect.
issues.observable: Text becomes blurry only after expanding a CDN row.

issues.title: 在最新版中吧显示模式改为单窗口模式的bug
subitems: Video pages visually overlap when switching videos in single-window mode.
issues.reason_to_assign: The report identifies a rendered page-overlap defect.
issues.observable: The next video page is drawn over the previous one.

issues.title: 单窗口模式全屏弹幕显示错误
subitems: Full-screen danmaku is positioned beyond the video’s vertical bounds.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear placement/containment defect in the overlay.
issues.observable: Danmaku extends slightly above the video image.

issues.title: 视频亮度问题
subitems: The brightness control produces a visibly incorrect image brightness.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is an appearance defect in the rendered picture.
issues.observable: The same video looks markedly darker in the app than on the web at comparable brightness settings.

issues.title: 单窗口模式-搜索透明背景
subitems: The description tab background becomes transparent after playing a searched video in single-window mode.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear background-rendering defect.
issues.observable: The description view turns transparent after the reported navigation sequence.

issues.title: 视频评论区的黄豆表情似乎有错位现象
subitems: The yellow-bean emoji is vertically misaligned in some comments.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a direct inline-image placement defect.
issues.observable: Standalone yellow-bean emoji sit too high relative to adjacent text.

issues.title: 番剧详情页样式错误
subitems: Anime-detail button text colors do not adapt to the theme and become unreadable.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a color/contrast presentation defect.
issues.observable: The right-side button labels are not visible against the selected theme.

issues.title: 单窗口模式全屏播放视频顶部弹幕被截断
subitems: The top row of danmaku is clipped in full-screen single-window mode.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear overlay clipping defect.
issues.observable: The topmost danmaku line is cut off in full screen.

issues.title: 播放视频暂停后左上角会出现内部透明的白色实线方框
subitems: Pausing in full screen draws an unwanted white outlined rectangle at the upper-left.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a transient visual artifact with no reported functional failure.
issues.observable: A transparent white rectangle flashes or remains after the first pause.

issues.title: 选中文字后右键菜单全选按钮缺少图标
subitems: The “Select all” context-menu command is missing its icon.
issues.reason_to_assign: The missing icon is a cosmetic subitem; the separate intermittent context-menu failure remains for logic review.
issues.observable: The Select all menu item appears without its expected icon.
pending_logic_subitems: The context menu sometimes fails to open after text selection.

issues.title: 个人主页动态修复后出现的相关bug
subitems: Some dynamic images are not scaled to their intended dimensions.
issues.reason_to_assign: The image-sizing problem is a clear layout subitem; missing dynamic text/article content and the wrong comment-panel type remain pending logic review.
issues.observable: Some feed images appear at incorrect dimensions or proportions.
pending_logic_subitems: Some dynamics omit text/article content; the dynamic comment area opens as a video-comment panel.

issues.title: Windows10下深色模式启动页面背景并非深色
subitems: On Windows 10, the startup background follows the system accent color instead of the dark theme.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear theme/background appearance defect.
issues.observable: The splash screen is bright orange rather than dark when Windows 10 is in dark mode.

issues.title: 弹幕字体显示异常
subitems: Live danmaku fonts render abnormally on the reported Windows 11 build.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a direct typography/rendering defect.
issues.observable: Danmaku characters have visibly abnormal font rendering.

issues.title: 点赞收藏投币按钮颜色错误
subitems: Like/favorite/coin buttons lose their selected color on hover.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear color/state-indicator rendering defect.
issues.observable: A selected action button returns to its default color when hovered.

issues.title: 内容过滤设置规则项在Win10中样式错误
subitems: On Windows 10, an unexpanded content-filter rule row is narrower than its expanded layout.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear width/alignment defect in the settings UI.
issues.observable: The rule row changes width when expanded.

issues.title: 超过100集以上的分p无法正常显示
subitems: The episode selector overflows when a video has more than 100 parts.
issues.reason_to_assign: The issue describes a visible overflow in the selector layout.
issues.observable: The part list does not fit/display normally above 100 episodes.

issues.title: 选集界面错误换行
subitems: Text wraps incorrectly in the episode-selection interface.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear text-layout defect.
issues.observable: Episode entries break onto the wrong lines.

issues.title: 动态评论区UI bug 和单窗口模式显示bug
subitems: The dynamic-comment panel has a transparent background that causes text to overlap.
issues.reason_to_assign: The body directly identifies a transparency/overlap presentation defect.
issues.observable: Text from the dynamic view overlaps through the comment panel background.

issues.title: 个人空间页动态评论背景透明问题
subitems: The dynamic-comment background in a profile page renders transparent.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear background-rendering defect.
issues.observable: The comment panel does not cover the content behind it.

issues.title: win11 24h2 全屏播放左上箭头不消失
subitems: A back arrow remains visible in the upper-left during full-screen playback.
issues.reason_to_assign: The report is a visible unwanted overlay/control-placement issue.
issues.observable: The upper-left back button cannot be hidden in full screen.

issues.title: 状态栏卡片右上角与功能键重叠
subitems: Status cards overlap the window’s minimize/maximize/close buttons.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear layout collision with visible controls.
issues.observable: With enough cards, they cover the window controls and can cause accidental clicks.

issues.title: biliuwp4.7.6版本详情页透明化
subitems: The video details panel renders transparent.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear rendering/background defect.
issues.observable: The details text is drawn over underlying content and is difficult to read.

issues.title: 部分控件颜色与设置主题不匹配
subitems: Some controls/text use colors that do not match the selected light theme.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a direct theme contrast/color defect.
issues.observable: Some labels are difficult to distinguish in light mode.

issues.title: 全屏化后有部分视频弹幕被遮挡
subitems: Some video danmaku are hidden/clipped at the top after entering full screen.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear overlay clipping/positioning defect.
issues.observable: The top part of some danmaku is obscured in full screen.

issues.title: 主题设置为跟随系统时颜色错误
subitems: Following the system theme selects incorrect colors.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear theme-color presentation defect.
issues.observable: Controls use the wrong colors when theme follows Windows.

issues.title: 直播间弹幕输入框×键与表情键重叠，概率触发自动删除
subitems: The close and emoji buttons in live-chat input overlap.
issues.reason_to_assign: The overlap is a clear visual-layout subitem; the separate deletion of the last typed character remains pending logic review.
issues.observable: The × and emoji controls occupy overlapping space beside the input.
pending_logic_subitems: Typing can delete the last character in live chat.

issues.title: 三大金刚键重复显示错误的颜色
subitems: The three window-control buttons repeat or display the wrong theme color.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear control-color appearance defect.
issues.observable: The minimize/maximize/close buttons use duplicate or incorrect colors.

issues.title: 自定义倍速界面和快捷键设置界面在Win10中宽度丢失
subitems: The custom-speed and shortcut-settings dialogs lose their width on Windows 10.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear dialog-layout defect.
issues.observable: Those settings screens appear too narrow on Windows 10.

issues.title: [Bug] 更改主题颜色为“跟随系统”后登陆界面文字不显示
subitems: Login-method labels disappear when the theme is set to follow the system.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear text-contrast/rendering defect; login behavior itself is not classified here.
issues.observable: The labels for SMS, QR, and password login are invisible.

issues.title: 直播间粉丝牌id以及等级丢失颜色
subitems: Live fan-badge IDs and levels lose their color and turn white.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear text-color presentation regression.
issues.observable: Badge text appears white instead of using its prior colors.

issues.title: 评论区用户名后方偶尔会出现奇怪的白色方块
subitems: Some comment usernames have unexplained white boxes rendered beside them.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear visible rendering artifact in the comment list.
issues.observable: White square artifacts appear beside some usernames.

issues.title: 评论区文本及元素没有对齐
subitems: Comment text and UI elements are misaligned in both collapsed and expanded comments.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a direct alignment/layout defect.
issues.observable: The comment rows do not align to the expected text/input edges.

issues.title: 直播间高能用户榜单文字重叠
subitems: Text and numbers overlap in the live high-energy-user ranking.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear typography/layout collision.
issues.observable: Names and numeric values run together in the ranking.

issues.title: 评论区点赞数显示不合理
subitems: Large like counts use an awkward display format (“57.0千” instead of “5.7万”).
issues.reason_to_assign: The underlying count is equivalent; the defect is its visible number formatting.
issues.observable: A large comment like count is formatted in an unexpected locale/unit style.

issues.title: 某些专栏正文内容显示异常
subitems: Article text overlaps the leading image in some columns.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a direct content-layout overlap defect.
issues.observable: Text below the first image is drawn on top of that image.

issues.title: 视频章节字体颜色问题
subitems: In light mode, chapter text is almost unreadable against its dark translucent background.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear theme contrast/color defect.
issues.observable: Chapter labels blend into the dark overlay in light mode.

issues.title: 文章阅读器样式错误
subitems: The article author avatar elements do not overlap as intended, leaving the avatar split across lines.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear alignment/layout defect in the article header.
issues.observable: The author avatar/header elements wrap onto separate lines.

issues.title: 高级弹幕无法正确显示/显示错误
subitems: Advanced danmaku render incorrectly in the player.
issues.reason_to_assign: The report is specifically about the visible rendering of advanced danmaku; no data/API or playback failure is described.
issues.observable: Advanced danmaku appear in the wrong form/position.

issues.title: 热门榜单大会员标签遮挡
subitems: A membership badge overlaps the title in the popular ranking list.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a direct element-overlap defect.
issues.observable: The badge covers enough of the title that the item name cannot be read.

issues.title: 弹幕过长时弹幕无法显示完全
subitems: Long danmaku are clipped at the end.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a clear text-clipping defect in the overlay.
issues.observable: The final characters of long danmaku are missing from view.

issues.title: 修复评论多图显示效果
subitems: The layout/display of multiple images in comments is incorrect.
issues.reason_to_assign: The title identifies a correction to existing multi-image presentation, a clear display/layout issue.
issues.observable: Comment images are arranged or rendered incorrectly.

issues.title: 4.8.16.1801版本无法循环播放
subitems: Two video-tab interfaces can overlap when opening another video.
issues.reason_to_assign: This is a visible page-overlap subitem; the separate loop-playback black-screen/hang remains pending logic review.
issues.observable: The second video tab is drawn on top of the first in the reported case.
pending_logic_subitems: Loop playback can end in a black loading screen and leave the app unresponsive.

issues.title: 预发布版本视频详情页关闭时出现残留
subitems: Player UI elements remain visible after the finished video tab is closed or switched away.
issues.reason_to_assign: The issue explicitly reports residual interface elements after page close, a clear visual lifecycle artifact.
issues.observable: Elements from the closed video page remain on screen.
